title: Rename fetch_user to load_user across callers, no behaviour change

notes.what: fetch_user is renamed load_user in the repository module and its two callers; nothing else changes. The old name is kept as a deprecated alias that warns.
notes.why: The team convention is load_ for database reads and fetch_ for HTTP; this one read from Postgres and kept confusing new people.
notes.edge: Code that imported fetch_user still works but emits a DeprecationWarning once per call site; test suites that turn warnings into errors will fail until they migrate.
notes.risk: Any dynamic lookup by string (getattr, a registry keyed by function name) would miss the rename; a grep for the string found none. The alias keeps third-party plugins working for one release.
notes.test: The existing repository tests pass unchanged after the import rename; one new test asserts the alias warns and returns the same object.
